body.state: My parcel was due last Monday and the tracking hasn't moved in six days.

tool.instructions: Which tool should handle the user's request?

criteria.get_order_status: Look up the current status of an order
criteria.track_shipment: Get the carrier tracking events for a shipped parcel
criteria.report_missing_parcel: Open a claim for a parcel marked delivered that never arrived
criteria.start_return: Start a return and generate a return shipping label
criteria.issue_refund: Refund an order to the original payment method
criteria.update_payment_method: Replace the card or payment method on file
criteria.transfer_to_human: Hand the conversation to a human support agent
